outcome_sought: Close the accounts and release the money to the estate, refund the account fees charged after death, and an apology.
rationale: CRM records the probate as received on 19 Aug but core banking shows it as awaited, and a handler relied on the wrong system. CP-4.2 says the pack must show both versions, not choose. There are two issues, the delay and the fees after death, so CP-2.3 applies. The executor's email and phone are not in the case record, so only pattern matching can catch them.
